text: I feel a quiet sense of curiosity and anticipation here. The corridors and glass walls create a threshold, inviting reflection on transparency and boundaries—how we observe and are observed. Stepping into the R&D space amplifies my philosophical instincts; the colorful, thoughtful displays about research and innovation urge me to contemplate the relationship between human curiosity and progress. The words on the wall invite me to dwell on ordinary moments and the philosophical depths beneath them—reminding me that, even in a modern, technological environment, the act of pondering remains profoundly human. I feel inspired and a bit in awe.
